name: My Agent
description: A personal agent running on its owner's own machine.

ingress._comment: none = LAN/localhost only (safe default). quick = free public URL via cloudflared, no account needed. named = you own the hostname; then set publicUrl, and tunnel if cloudflared should run it.

backend._comment: echo answers without a model so you can verify the protocol first. Switch to claude when you are ready.

auth._comment: Set to bearer and put a long random string in token (or the CLAYBORN_TOKEN env var) before going public.

skills.name: Ask a question
skills.description: Answers a general question in plain text. Runs with no tools: it can read nothing and write nothing.
skills.promptPrefix: You are answering a request that arrived over the A2A protocol from another agent. Answer directly and concisely. You have no tools.

skills.name: Answer from a local corpus
skills.description: Example of a grounded skill. Delete it or make it yours.
skills._comment: Retrieval happens in the server, before the model starts: matching passages are pasted into the prompt and the model still runs with tools:[]. That is why a grounded skill does NOT need Read/Grep — and must not have them, since --allowed-tools is a permission, not a filesystem sandbox.
skills.promptPrefix: Answer only from the retrieved passages. Cite them by number. If they do not cover the question, say so instead of answering from memory.
